Top-middle: round wooden lift platform, exterior diameter 2.5m, stout weathered dark timber planks fitted as a disc with two iron straps, top view; no stone, no rope, no frame. Bottom-middle: long low horizontal band of weathered limestone wall foundation, top edge pale rim, front deeply damp dark mineral seams and thin pale salt tide lines, footprint2.8x.8m, top-down shallow recessed architectural sprite, no water pool or floor. Bottom-right: low square ancient funerary plinth of limestone slabs, exact 2.12x2.12m footprint, broad top slab with eroded grooves and corner drain channels, modest beveled clear pale edges, tiny mineral traces in seams; no coffin or props.
